descriptions.zh: 传感器检测到[This.System.GetName]星系中存在一个向整个星系发出原始信号的物体。这些相同的信号模式也曾在来自未知区域的长程扫描仪上被记录到。虽然目前尚不清楚这些信号是否具有意图，但需要进一步调查。
descriptions.en: Sensors indicate a presence in the [This.System.GetName] system that is sending rudimentary signals across the galaxy. These same patterns have been registered on long-range scanners originating from parts unknown. Though it is not clear whether these signals are intentional in nature, it warrants further investigation.

descriptions.zh: 我们发现，这些远距离信号源于一种简单的太空生物，我们将其命名为§H“虚空虫”§!。似乎整个星系都充满了这种生物。根据信号的不同波长，我们确定这些生物在达到最终成熟之前会经历多个生长阶段。虽然它们表面上看起来并不具有攻击性，但它们的交流模式表明它们在星系范围内进行着协调。
descriptions.en: We have discovered that the far-reaching signals originate from a simple spaceborne organism we have taken to calling §H"Voidworms"§!. It appears that the galaxy is riddled with these creatures. From the varying wavelengths of the signals, we have determined that the creatures develop through several stages of growth before reaching final maturity. Though they do not appear outwardly aggressive, their patterns of communication indicate coordination on a galactic scale.

descriptions.zh: 这些寄生生物天生无法繁殖，必须依赖从星球上的宿主获取养分。为了让§H“虚空虫”§!产生三头虫成长必不可少的激素，它们必须从有人居住的星球上获取足够的有机物质。作为雌雄同体的生物，它们选择伴侣主要取决于互补的物理特征和相似的体型。
descriptions.en: These parasitic creatures lack the natural ability to reproduce and must rely on the acquisition of planet-borne hosts. Sufficient organic matter must be harvested from inhabited planets for the §H"Voidworms"§! to produce a crucial hormone within their mating trios, known as "troikas". As hermaphroditic creatures, the selection of partners is determined primarily by complementary physical traits and comparable size.

descriptions.zh:
虚空虫以三只为一组交配，这种形态被称为“三头虫”。这些生物的一生都被绑定在永无止境的交配仪式中。然而，它们需要外部生物宿主才能繁殖后代。

它们是寄生虫。

虚空虫成熟后，会在其生殖系统内发育出一窝囊肿。这些保护性囊肿包含高腐蚀性的配子，当与三头虫中的其他配子结合时，可以被发送到具有合适生物量的星球上，以产下更多幼虫。它们的宿主无法在这一过程中存活。我们已经看到证据表明，虚空虫会协调它们的轰炸，以便在整个星系中维持可持续数量的可用宿主。

无论如何，我们相信我们可以利用它们的生殖酶的力量来造福我们自己。我们甚至可以对它们的繁殖活动产生免疫力。
descriptions.en:
Voidworms mate in groups of three, a formation known as a "Troika." These creatures become bound for life in a never-ending mating ritual. However, they require an external biological host to produce offspring.

They are parasites.

Upon reaching maturity, each Voidworm develops a clutch of cysts within their reproductive systems. These protective cysts contain highly caustic gametes that, when combined with others in a Troika, can be sent to planets with suitable biomass in order to give birth to more of their nymphs. Their hosts do not survive this process. We've seen evidence that the Voidworms coordinate their bombardments so as to maintain a sustainable amount of viable hosts throughout the galaxy.

In any case, we believe that we can harness the power of their reproductive enzymes to our own benefit. We may even develop an immunity to their reproductive efforts.

label.zh: 利用他们的生育能力来满足我们自己的需求。
label.en: Harness their fertility for our own needs.

descriptions.zh:
虚空虫的最后一个家园星系已经被摧毁，它们物种也已灭绝。

我们不再需要担心它们的寄生攻击。
descriptions.en:
The last of the Voidworm home systems has been destroyed, and their species has been eradicated.

We need no longer concern ourselves with their parasitic bombardments.

descriptions.zh:
我们已经铲除了一个虚空虫的母星系。

它们将无法再利用这些产卵地来抚育幼虫。
descriptions.en:
We have eradicated a Voidworm home system.

They will no longer be able to make use of these spawning grounds to raise their young.

descriptions.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已宣布，所有虚空虫不再被允许进入成员国的恒星系。

在它们被消灭或自行离开我们的宇域之前，[this.GetName]将被视为§R违反星系法§!。
descriptions.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has declared that all Voidworms are no longer permitted within member nation systems.

Until they are eliminated or leave our space of their own accord, the [this.GetName] will be considered in §RBreach of Galactic Law§!.

descriptions.zh:
一支虚空虫舰队已进入[from.GetName]星系内的我们的空间。作为[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]成员，我们有法律义务立即处决在我们边界内的任何虚空虫。

[this.GetName]将被视为§R违反星系法§!，直到虚空虫离开我们的空间或被消灭。
descriptions.en:
A fleet of Voidworms has entered our space in the [from.GetName] system. As a [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] member, we are legally obliged to immediately euthanize any Voidworms present within our borders.

The [this.GetName] will be considered in §RBreach of Galactic Law§! until the Voidworms have either departed our space or are exterminated.

options.script: name = OK

descriptions.zh: 虚空虫一直存在于我们的[invaded_system.GetName]星系，使我们严重§R违反了星系法§!中关于虚空虫灭绝决议的内容。这导致[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]允许成员投票对[this.GetName]实施制裁。
descriptions.en: The continued Voidworm presence in our [invaded_system.GetName] system is a significant §RBreach of Galactic Law§! under the Voidworm Eradication resolution. This has resulted in [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] allowing members to vote for sanctions to be imposed on [this.GetName].

descriptions.zh:
[from.GetName]正在遭受攻击。

一大群虚空虫正在殖民地轨道上，用寄生囊肿进行轰炸。

每个囊肿都包含一个剧毒孢子，对我们的殖民者以及所有生命都极其致命。一旦被摄入，它会迅速发育成为一只若虫，并会暴力地从宿主体内破茧而出，彻底摧毁宿主。这些若虫体内有一个压缩气体囊，使它们能够上升到高层大气，在那里它们会本能地将自己推进到预定的目的地。

生物分析表明，每窝虚空虫都拥有有限数量的囊肿，它们很可能在囊肿耗尽后离开。但在那之前，我们会遭受严重的人口损失。
descriptions.en:
[from.GetName] is under attack.

A large group of Voidworms is in orbit of the colony, bombarding it with parasitic cysts.

Each cyst contains a toxic spore that is extremely deadly not only to our colonists, but all life. Once ingested, it rapidly gestates into a nymph that will emerge violently and completely destroy its host. These nymphs contain a bladder of compressed gases that allows them to ascend the upper atmosphere, where they instinctively propel themselves to a predetermined destination.

Biological analysis indicates that each clutch of Voidworms has a limited supply of these cysts to distribute, and it is likely they will depart once all are depleted. Until then, we are suffering significant population loss.

生物分析表明，每窝虚空虫都拥有有限数量的囊肿，它们很可能在囊肿耗尽后离开。但在那之前，我们会遭受严重的人口损失。
descriptions.en:
[from.GetName] is under attack.

A large group of Voidworms is in orbit of the colony, bombarding it with parasitic cysts.

Each cyst contains a toxic spore that is extremely deadly to all native fauna. Once ingested, it rapidly gestates into a nymph that will emerge violently and completely destroy its host. The nymphs, which normally feed on asteroids for their precious metals, opportunistically hunt and feed upon our vulnerable [this.GetColonistPlural].  Each hatchling contains a bladder of compressed gases that allows them to ascend to the upper atmosphere, where they instinctively propel themselves to a predetermined destination.

Biological analysis indicates that each clutch of Voidworms has a limited supply of these cysts to distribute, and it is likely they will depart once all are depleted. Until then, we are suffering significant population loss.

descriptions.zh:
星系中虚空虫的数量已达到临界值，它们的习性正在发生显著变化。

它们生命周期中原本会放任宿主物种繁衍一段时间的阶段已打破，它们似乎不再顾及这些产卵地是否能够维持可持续性。

我们所有殖民地都已进入红色警戒状态。在任何星系中发现虚空虫，都应极其谨慎地应对。

一场泛星系级的繁殖狂潮正在向我们袭来。
descriptions.en:
The population of Voidworms in the galaxy has reached a critical mass. Their behavior is noticeably changing.

The typical stage of their lifecycle where host populations would be spared has been disrupted. There seems to be no further regard for the sustainability of their spawning grounds.

All of our colonies are on red alert. The presence of Voidworms in any system should be met with extreme caution.

A breeding frenzy on the galactic scale is upon us.

The population of Voidworms in the galaxy has reached a critical mass. Their behavior is noticeably changing.

The typical stage of their lifecycle where host populations would be spared has been disrupted. There seems to be no further regard for the sustainability of their spawning grounds.

All of our colonies are on red alert. The presence of Voidworms in any system should be met with extreme caution.

A breeding frenzy on the galactic scale is upon us.

The immunity we have previously developed against these parasites is no longer working to the same degree. We will need to go back to the drawing board.

descriptions.zh: 整个星系都在疯传一个令人不安的消息：一种此前不为人知的太空兽群“虚空虫”正在疯狂繁殖。据说，对于那些防御系统不够完善的恒星系来说，这些生物构成了巨大的威胁。我们所有的殖民地现在都已经进入了最高警戒状态。
descriptions.en: Disturbing reports are being intercepted across the galaxy that a previously unknown species of space fauna known as "Voidworms" have entered a reproductive frenzy. These creatures are reportedly a significant threat to planets without adequate system defenses. All of our colonies are now on red alert.

descriptions.zh: 我们在对抗虚空虫的行动中，由于改良了维护协议，舰队支援力度提升，意外获得了大量额外的零件。我们有机会将这些材料投入到提高新舰队的短期生产中。
descriptions.en: Our increased fleet support in efforts against the Voidworms has yielded an unexpected windfall of additional components due to improved maintenance protocols. We have an opportunity to invest these materials into improving our short-term production of new fleets.

descriptions.en: Our continued preparations against the Voidworm menace has inspired a new generation of Commanders. Experienced citizens of [this.GetName] have chosen to offer their talents toward the elimination of this galactic threat.

descriptions.zh: 我们针对虚空虫威胁进行了持续的准备工作，使我们能够生产出额外的指挥官级领袖节点。由于我们为舰队提供额外的支援，这些战斗型节点能够获得更多资源，以促进其快速融入我们的军事行动之中。
descriptions.en: Our continued preparations against the Voidworm menace has allowed us to produce additional Commander-class leadership nodes. By providing additional support to our fleets, these Combat-focused nodes have received increased resources to facilitate their swift integration into our military efforts.

descriptions.zh: 驻扎在[random_shipyard.GetName]的工程师开发了一种新的舰船防御概念蓝图。[random_shipyard.leader.GetHeSheCap]在对抗虚空虫的战斗中进行例行维修时，[random_shipyard.leader.GetHeShe]灵机一动，想出了一个可以提高舰船坚固性的新组件。该想法提交给我们的研究部门后，我们认为它具有巨大的潜力。
descriptions.en: An engineer stationed on [random_shipyard.GetName] has developed a new conceptual blueprint for ship defenses. [random_shipyard.leader.GetHeSheCap] was carrying out routine repairs in the fight against the Voidworms when [random_shipyard.leader.GetHeShe] came up with an idea for a new component that would increase the hardiness of our vessels. After the idea was presented to our research department, we believe that it has great potential.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { is_gestalt = no }

descriptions.zh: 驻扎在[random_shipyard.GetName]的维修[root.GetIndividualName]激发了新的研究观点，能够改进舰船防御。在例行维修期间的一次误操作中，该[root.GetIndividualName]使用了一种奇特的材料和方法组合，创造了一种新的防护组件。经过对研究可能性进行论证，这一意外发现经过改进后可以展现出巨大潜力。
descriptions.en: A repair [root.GetIndividualName] stationed on [random_shipyard.GetName] has inspired new research insights to improve ship defenses. After a miscommunication during routine repairs, the [root.GetIndividualName] used a peculiar combination of methods and materials to create a new protective component. After investigating the research possibilities, this accidental discovery has shown great potential once refined.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { is_gestalt = yes }

descriptions.zh:
在履行[infected_leader.GetHisHer]的职责期间，[infected_leader.GetName]感染了活跃的虚空虫孢子。新的若虫很快就会出现并摧毁它们的宿主。

这可能是一场徒劳的战斗，但医务人员推测，在幼虫完全融入[infected_leader.GetHisHer]的神经系统之前，可能可以将其取出。这是一场风险很大的手术，但[infected_leader.GetName]似乎愿意让我们尝试。
descriptions.en:
In the performance of [infected_leader.GetHisHer] duties, [infected_leader.GetName] [infected_leader.GetHasHave] become infected with active Voidworm spores. It will not be long until new nymphs emerge and destroy their host.

It could be a lost cause, but the medical staff speculate it may be possible to extract the larva before they have fully integrated into [infected_leader.GetHisHer] nervous system. It's a risky procedure, but [infected_leader.GetName] seems willing to let us try.

descriptions.zh: 一小群被感染的[infected_planet_pop.species.GetName]从[infected_planet.GetName]的净化行动中逃脱，并分散到我们的恒星系中。如果不加控制，这会导致虚空虫感染蔓延到整个[this.GetName]。必须赶在这些逃亡者威胁到我们所有人之前尽快处理掉。
descriptions.en: A small group of infected [infected_planet_pop.species.GetName] have fled from the purge on [infected_planet.GetName] and dispersed throughout our systems. Left unchecked, this could cause Voidworm infection to spread across the entire [this.GetName]. Those who fled must be dealt with before they endanger us all.

descriptions.zh: 一小群被感染的[infected_planet_pop.species.GetName]从[infected_planet.GetName]的净化行动中逃脱，并分散到我们的恒星系中。如果不加控制，这会导致虚空虫感染蔓延到整个[this.GetName]。必须赶在这些逃亡者威胁到我们其他的活体陈设之前尽快处理掉。
descriptions.en: A small group of infected [infected_planet_pop.species.GetName] have fled from the purge on [infected_planet.GetName] and dispersed throughout our systems. Left unchecked, this could cause Voidworm infection to spread across the entire [this.GetName]. Those who fled must be dealt with before they endanger our other bio-trophies.

descriptions.zh: 用于分析的受感染动植物样本被错误地当作普通食物进行处理。由于这个错误，大量有机物被虚空虫的寄生虫污染，必须进行处理。
descriptions.en: Samples of infected flora and fauna marked for analysis were somehow erroneously processed as typical foodstuffs. Following this error, a large quantity of organic matter has been contaminated by Voidworm parasites and must now be disposed of.

tooltips.en: Additional voidworm nymphs may appear near our colonies!

descriptions.zh:
虽然清除感染者被认为是最明智的行动方针，但许多士兵却难以执行命令。尽管虚空虫的寄生虫危险性很高，但许多士兵仍然无法为了更大的利益而消灭自己的同胞。

必须采取措施阻止虚空虫感染在我们的殖民地蔓延。我们可以尝试将清除过程的某些环节自动化，从而减少对士兵的需求。或者，我们可以发起短暂的宣传活动，宣传我们清除行动的道德标准，并重申其必要性。
descriptions.en:
While it is agreed that purging the infected is the wisest course of action, many soldiers are struggling to carry out orders. Despite the danger of the Voidworm parasite, many are simply unable to eliminate their fellow citizens for the greater good.

Something must be done to prevent the Voidworm infection from spreading through our colonies. We may be able to automate certain parts of the purging process so as to require fewer soldiers. Alternatively, we can launch a short publicity campaign to promote the ethical standards of our purging efforts and reaffirm their necessity.

options.conditions: trigger = { NOT = { has_valid_civic = civic_media_conglomerate } }

descriptions.zh: 我们对虚空虫瘟疫的治疗方法的探索，也促进了其他生物学领域的平行研究。虽然寄生虫目前仍是我们的首要任务，但这一新的突破在未来研究中具有巨大潜力。
descriptions.en: Our search for the cure to the Voidworm plague has allowed research in other biological fields to progress in parallel. While the parasites remain our current priority, this new breakthrough has tremendous potential for future study.

descriptions.zh:
我们对虚空虫疫的理解正在提高，并且已经开发出治愈方法的基础。然而，如果能在[owner_main_species.GetAdj]参与者身上进行早期活体测试，我们的研究进度将会快得多。

撇开伦理考量不谈，为了更大的利益，绕过某些安全措施或许是明智之举。
descriptions.en:
Our understanding of the Voidworm Plague is improving and the foundation of a cure has been developed. However, our research could progress at a much quicker pace with early-stage live testing on [owner_main_species.GetAdj] participants.

Ethical considerations aside, it may be wiser to bypass certain safety measures for the sake of the greater good.

descriptions.zh:
我们对虚空虫疫的理解正在提高，并且已经开发出治愈方法的基础。然而，测试过程非常耗时，主要原因是需要不断地将未分配的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]作为测试对象。如果[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]可以简单地重新分配成为测试对象，那么治愈方案的开发速度将会加快。

然而，这种做法会对整个集体造成其他影响，重新分配的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]将导致其先前角色陷入混乱。
descriptions.en:
Our understanding of the Voidworm Plague is improving and the foundation of a cure has been developed. However, the testing process is time-consuming, primarily due to the constant need for idle [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] as subjects. If [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] could simply be reassigned to become test subjects, the cure would develop at a faster rate.

The consequences would be felt elsewhere throughout the collective, with reassigned [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] leaving their previous role in disarray.

descriptions.zh:
我们发现了虚空虫繁殖周期中的一个规律，这可能在合成治疗虚空虫疫的药物方面带来重大突破。

为了验证这一假设，必须从一只野生虚空三头虫中采集其生殖腺进行分析。至关重要的是，这只虚空三头虫必须在轰炸星球的过程中被杀死，才能保存活跃的生殖配子。
descriptions.en:
We have discovered a pattern in the reproduction cycle of Voidworms that could lead to a huge breakthrough in synthesizing a cure to the Voidworm Plague.

To confirm this hypothesis, the reproductive glands of a wild Voidworm Troika must be harvested for analysis. Crucially, this Voidworm Troika must be killed while bombarding a planet in order to preserve the active reproductive gametes.

label.en: We have no time for this.

options.script: name = grand_archive.2450.a

descriptions.zh:
从可育的“三头虫”形态的虚空虫身上取回的腺体揭示关于它们生殖循环的新信息。

每一只处于繁殖拥抱中的虚空虫都会将遗传物质均匀分布，有效地形成一个全新的有机体，深锁于交配仪式中直到死亡。

我们可以利用这些展现出遗传延展性的过程来对付他们。
descriptions.en:
The glands recovered from the fertile Voidworm Troika revealed new information about their reproductive cycles.

Locked in a mating ritual until death, each of the three Voidworms in reproductive embrace distribute their genetic material equally between themselves, effectively becoming a new organism entirely.

We can use these processes of genetic malleability against them.

descriptions.zh: 我们终于研制出了彻底根治虚空虫寄生感染的方法。从此以后，我们的殖民地再也不用担心那些可怕的孢子袭击了，星系中这些虫子的存在也不再是我们需要操心的问题了。
descriptions.en: We have completed the development of an ultimate cure to the Voidworm parasitic infection. Our colonies are no longer susceptible to their spore bombardments, and we need no longer be concerned about their presence in the galaxy.

descriptions.zh:
我们终于研制出了彻底根治虚空虫寄生感染的方法。从此以后，我们的殖民地再也不用担心那些可怕的孢子袭击了，星系中这些虫子的存在也不再是我们需要操心的问题了。

我们确信，这一次，我们开发的治疗方法已经能够防范他们生物学上的任何未来突变。
descriptions.en:
We have completed the development of an ultimate cure to the Voidworm parasitic infection. Our colonies are no longer susceptible to their spore bombardments, and we need no longer be concerned about their presence in the galaxy.

We are certain that, this time, the cure we have developed is safeguarded against any future mutation of their biology.

descriptions.en: The irregular asteroid we encountered in §H[This.System.GetName]§! appears to be sentient in nature. Approaching the orbit of such objects is highly dangerous, and Science Ships are advised to leave affected systems immediately until we know more about these entities.

descriptions.zh:
我们发现了一种居住在小行星外壳内的太空生物，将其命名为§H岩居兽§!。它们是一种可以埋伏数年只为给猎物致命一击的伏击掠食者。它们极度危险，能吞下整艘舰船，所以在探索那些未调查的小行星带时务必格外小心。

好消息是，它们的数量非常稀少，而且无性繁殖流程可能要花费上百年。
descriptions.en:
We have discovered a spaceborne organism that shelters inside of asteroids. Known to us as "§HCutholoids§!", these creatures are ambush predators that are capable of lying in wait for several years to capture their prey. Capable of engulfing entire ships, we should be very careful when approaching unsurveyed asteroid belts as they are found to be extremely dangerous.

The good news is that they appear to be quite rare, and their asexual reproductive processes can take hundreds of years.

descriptions.zh: 我们认为这些生物会根据大小和矿物成分来选择用哪颗小星星来作为巢穴。虽然我们遇到的第一个样本对[GetCommonMineral]具有生物学偏好，但每个个体很可能随着时间的推移根据其当前环境发展出不同的适应性。扫描显示这种金属的痕迹遍布宿主小行星，以及§H“岩居兽”§!本身的神经系统和消化道。
descriptions.en: We believe that the creatures select their asteroids based on mineral composition as well as size. While the first specimen we encountered possesses a biological preference for [GetCommonMineral], it is likely each individual develops this adaptation over time based on their current environment. Scans show that traces of this metal are present throughout the host asteroid, as well as within the nervous system and digestive tract of the §H"Cutholoid"§! Itself.

label.zh: 我们应该进一步研究这些生物。
label.en: We should study these creatures further.

descriptions.zh:
岩居兽的外壳并不只是矿物而已，其中还有生物纤维补强。这些纤维一直都在生长，这种外壳中估计包含了超过一半的生物质。

当岩居兽长得住不下小行星时，他们会寻找下一个新家并再次开始整合流程。虽然它们通常具有很强的领地意识，但在极佳的外壳候选品的轨道上也会出现多只岩居兽，其中最大的一只将占据这颗新的小行星，而其他个体将按大小排序，和平地交换外壳。通过这种方式，它们居住的小行星往往会交换十几手之多。

最终的结果是，最小的小行星会因为交换频繁反而得到了最多的生物强化。这些样品具有重要的科学价值。
descriptions.en:
The shell of a Cutholoid is not mineral alone, but reinforced with strong biological fibers. These fibers never stop growing, and the composition of some shells is estimated to be over fifty percent biomass.

When a Cutholoid grows too large for its asteroid, it will seek another home and begin the integration process again. While they are normally highly territorial, multiple Cutholoids have been observed in orbit of a prime shell candidate. The largest of the creatures will occupy the fresh asteroid, while others will order themselves by size and peacefully swap with the next in line. In this way, the asteroids they inhabit have often been occupied by dozens of previous organisms.

The end result is that the smallest asteroids have the highest amount of biological reinforcement, as they have been exchanged most often. These samples contain significant scientific value.

descriptions.zh:
我们的一艘科研船在[cutholoid_under_radar.solar_system.GetName]调查一颗奇怪的小行星时失去了联系。

在他们最后失踪的地点探测到了微弱的应急信号，我如果要找回这艘失踪的舰船就需要进一步调查。
descriptions.en:
Contact has been lost with our Science Ship while investigating a strange asteroid in [cutholoid_under_radar.solar_system.GetName].

We are detecting weak emergency signals from their last known location, and should investigate further if we intend to recover the missing vessel.

descriptions.en:
Another of the strange asteroidal creatures have been discovered in §H[from.solar_system.GetName]§! during routine exploration.

We should avoid this system with our §HScience Ships§! until we know more about these dangerous objects.

descriptions.zh:
[fromfrom.GetName]中的小行星只是一只栖居在里面的巨大有机体的外壳。

我们成功地将其摧毁，并找回了[this.GetName]。此后调查小行星的时候可得小心了。

可能还有其他的这种生物潜藏于此，等待着不小心的猎物。不幸的是，[leader.GetName]遭受到了一些不可修复的损伤。
descriptions.en:
The asteroid in [fromfrom.GetName] served only as a shell for a massive organism living inside.

We have successfully destroyed it and recovered [this.GetName]. Caution should be taken in further investigations of asteroids.

More of these creatures may be out there, lying in wait of easy prey. Unfortunately, [leader.GetName] suffered some irreparable harm.

descriptions.zh:
我们在§H[current_system.GetName]§!失踪的科研船回来了！

§H[leader.GetName]§!发回的报道称，他们被一个藏在小行星中的太空实体整个吞下，最后在船体就要承受不住的时候意外地被吐了出来。似乎有什么别的东西把这个生物吓了一跳让我们侥幸逃脱。

在有更多的认知之前，探索这片小行星带可要多加小心了。
descriptions.en:
Our Science Ship lost in §H[current_system.GetName]§! has returned!

Reports have come in from §H[leader.GetName]§! that they had been swallowed whole by a spaceborne entity hiding inside of an asteroid, and were at the limits of hull integrity before being unexpectedly ejected to safety. It appears something else has surprised the creature before we could intervene.

We should be cautious in our approach of certain asteroid belts until we can learn more.

[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已宣布，所有岩居兽不再被允许进入成员国的恒星系。

在它们被消灭或自行离开我们的宇域之前，[Root.GetName]将被视为§R违反星系法§!。
descriptions.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has declared that Cutholoids are no longer permitted within member nation systems.

Once discovered, these creatures must be destroyed, else the [Root.GetName] will be considered in §RBreach of Galactic Law§!.

[from.GetName]恒星系内发现了一只岩居兽。在[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]将其指定为危险害兽之后，成员国有法律义务立即处决在边界内的所有岩居兽。

[Root.GetName]将被视为§R违反星系法§!，直到岩居兽离开我们的星系或被消灭为止。
descriptions.en:
A Cutholoid has been discovered in the [from.GetName] system. Following their designation as a dangerous pest, all [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] members are legally obliged to immediately euthanize any Cutholoids present within their borders.

The [Root.GetName] will be considered in §RBreach of Galactic Law§! until the Cutholoid has been exterminated or otherwise driven from our systems.

descriptions.zh:
我们城邦的遗孤得知你们建造了一座§Y博物天枢§!，可以同时容纳大量的观众。与所有寻求这方面知识的人分享我们星系的历史，这是一个值得赞扬的倡议。我们在这方面志同道合。

我们希望能帮助你们实现这一目标。尽管我们已经四分五裂，但仍会尽我们最后的余力来帮助你们充实§Y收藏§!。
descriptions.en:
The last remnants of our order have received information that you have built a §YGrand Archive§! capable of supporting attendance on a massive scale. This is a commendable initiative in sharing our galaxy's history with all who seek such knowledge. We share common goals in this respect.

We are interested in helping you pursue this endeavor. Though our order has been recently shattered, we will use our remaining assets to provide assistance as you expand your §YCollection§!.

descriptions.zh:

我们希望能帮助你们实现这一目标。继续充实你的§Y收藏§!，我们将会尽己所能提供帮助。
descriptions.en:
We have received information that you have built a §YGrand Archive§! capable of supporting attendance on a massive scale. This is a commendable initiative in sharing our galaxy's history with all who seek such knowledge. We share common goals in this respect.

We are interested in helping you pursue this endeavor. Continue to expand your §YCollection§!, and we will in turn offer our support however we can.

descriptions.zh:
随着我们继续在这个星球上净化那些肮脏的异星渣滓，我们的[GetCollectionRewardCategory]战利品收集愈发充盈。

希望这些展品能成为这个污秽星系的残骸，进一步激励我们履行誓言。
descriptions.en:
As we continue our efforts to cleanse this world of filthy xeno scum, our collection of [GetCollectionRewardCategory] trophies has grown.

May these exhibits serve as the carcass of this contaminated galaxy and further inspire us in our sworn mission.

在我们的监控下，这些物品将在有机生命体从这个星系中灭绝很久之后依然存在。
descriptions.en:
We have gathered a selection of [GetCollectionRewardCategory] items that the organics believed to hold value as unique artifacts.

Under our surveillance, these items will endure long after organic life has been exterminated from this galaxy.

descriptions.zh:
我们继续从这个肮脏的恒星系中收集[GetCollectionRewardCategory]物品，奇珍异宝和古怪的东西。

让我们花点时间欣赏我们的战利品，但要知道，外面还有更多东西等着我们去获取。
descriptions.en:
We continue to amass [GetCollectionRewardCategory] objects, baubles and oddities from this filthy galaxy.

Let us take a moment to admire our trophies, but know that there is so much more out there to take.

descriptions.zh:
我们继续收集[GetCollectionRewardCategory]饰品，这些饰品是低等生命形式播下的污染的残余。

一旦所有令人作呕的异形都被从星空中清除，这些物品将提醒我们它们低等的本质。
descriptions.en:
We continue to amass [GetCollectionRewardCategory] trinkets, remnants of the contamination that has been sown by inferior lifeforms.

Once every disgusting xeno has been purged from the stars, these items will remind us of their inferior nature.

descriptions.zh:

当我们享用美食时，这些物品将提醒我们回忆那些已经消耗了无数次的盛宴。
descriptions.en:
We continue to amass [GetCollectionRewardCategory] specimens, ancient pieces of the flesh of this galaxy.

As we feast, these items will serve to remind us of the countless fodder we have consumed.

descriptions.zh:

descriptions.en:

descriptions.zh:

descriptions.en:

These items will serve to remind us of illogicity of organic life in the service of future extermination protocols.

我们已经用[GetCollectionRewardCategory]的物品填满了我们的仓库，这些是这个星系的古老血肉。

我们认为这庞大的收藏是记录我们毁灭一切的证明。让所有人都见证我们的胜利。
descriptions.en:
We have filled our stores with [GetCollectionRewardCategory] objects, the ancient flesh of this galaxy.

We consider this vast collection to be a record of our destruction of it all. Let all gaze upon our triumphs.

descriptions.zh:
我们已经用[GetCollectionRewardCategory]奇物填满了我们的仓库，这些奇物是毫无意义的外星装饰品的宝库。

我们看着这庞大的收藏，嘲笑我们那些可怜的低等生物。想想吧，一旦他们被消灭，这些展示柜将是他们留下的唯一遗迹。
descriptions.en:
We have filled our stores with [GetCollectionRewardCategory] curios, a veritable wealth of meaningless xeno ornaments.

We look upon this vast collection and laugh at the pitiful nature of our inferiors. To think, once they have been exterminated, these display cases will be all that remain of them.

这庞大的收藏只提醒着我们那无法满足的饥渴。当这片星系被完全吞噬后，我们将看着这些物品，回味着品尝的记忆。
descriptions.en:

This vast collection serves only to remind us of the hunger that cannot be sated. Once this galaxy has been devoured in full, we will look upon these items and savor the memories of taste.

We have been able to salvage much of the alloys used in its original construction. We will need to rebuild the structure entirely in another system to continue exhibitions.

We have detected a faint signal from somewhere on [event_target:treasure_trove_planet.GetName]. Based on the rudimentary cryptography, we believe this to be from a long-lost pirate's §YTreasure Trove§!.

It will take some effort, but we're confident we would be able to unearth its secrets.

descriptions.zh: 我们小心地解除了海盗藏于[event_target:treasure_trove_planet.GetName]的§Y珍宝藏库§!的武装后我们在一个密封容器内发现了一件远古海盗文物。这段海盗史将加入我们的收藏。
descriptions.en: After carefully disarming the defenses of the pirate's hidden §YTreasure Trove§! on [event_target:treasure_trove_planet.GetName], we have discovered an ancient pirate artifact preserved in a sealed container. This piece of buccaneer history will be added to our collection.

descriptions.zh:
在小心地破解了遗失的§Y珍宝藏库§!之后，我们发现了通往下方星球上一个点的模糊方向。我们在那里又发现了一艘由反探测阵列保护的令人难以置信的海盗战舰。

该舰船名为[treasure_trove_pirate_ship.GetName]，现已加入加入我们的军队。
descriptions.en:
After carefully disarming the lost §YTreasure Trove§!, we discovered analogue directions leading to a point on the planet below. There we found an incredible pirate battleship protected by an anti-detection array.

This ship, named [treasure_trove_pirate_ship.GetName], has been claimed for our military.

descriptions.zh:
我们小心地解除了海盗藏于[event_target:treasure_trove_planet.GetName]的§Y珍宝藏库§!的武装后我们发现了一个存有宝贵研究论文的数据库。

其来源尚不清楚，但可以加以好好利用。
descriptions.en:
After carefully disarming the defenses of the pirate's hidden §YTreasure Trove§! on [event_target:treasure_trove_planet.GetName], we have discovered a databank of rare and valuable research papers.

How these were obtained is unknown, but we can make good use of them.

descriptions.zh:
我们小心地解除了海盗藏于[event_target:treasure_trove_planet.GetName]的§Y珍宝藏库§!的武装后，找到了一箱价值不菲的资源。

我们会好好利用这份意外收获的。
descriptions.en:
After carefully disarming the defenses of the pirate's hidden §YTreasure Trove§! on [event_target:treasure_trove_planet.GetName], we have uncovered a cache of valuable resources.

We will make good use of this unexpected bounty.

descriptions.zh: 此外，我们还在巨大的§Y珍宝藏库§!内发现一件远古海盗文物。通过小心的复原，这段海盗史将加入我们的收藏。
descriptions.en: Additionally, we have discovered an ancient pirate artifact hidden within the vast §YTreasure Trove§!. With careful restoration, this piece of buccaneer history will make a wonderful addition to our collection.

options.script: name = grand_archive.6015.a

descriptions.zh:
我们在[from.GetName]搜寻§Y珍宝藏库§!的过程中，[fromfromfrom.Leader.GetName][fromfromfrom.Leader.GetWasWere]遭到了一支海盗舰队的伏击！

这些法外狂徒不知怎么发现了我们的进展，打算把这些宝物据为己有。如果我们想要拿到这些宝藏，就必须在他们抢到之前打败他们的舰队。
descriptions.en:
As we were searching for the §YTreasure Trove§! on [from.GetName], [fromfromfrom.Leader.GetName] [fromfromfrom.Leader.GetWasWere] ambushed by a pirate fleet!

These outlaws have somehow trailed our progress and seek to take the treasure for themselves. If we are to collect this bounty, we must defeat their fleet before they secure the valuables.

descriptions.zh: 在击溃了投机取巧的海盗之后，我们可以自由地索取[event_target:treasure_trove_planet.GetName]的宝藏了。
descriptions.en: Having routed the opportunistic pirates, we are now free to claim the treasure trove on [event_target:treasure_trove_planet.GetName].

descriptions.zh:
投机取巧的海盗抢走了[event_target:treasure_trove_planet.GetName]的§Y珍宝藏库§!。

现在已经没剩什么值得一提的东西了。
descriptions.en:
The opportunistic pirates have plundered the §YTreasure Trove§! on [event_target:treasure_trove_planet.GetName].

There is nothing of value left for us to take.

options.script: name = grand_archive.6035.a

descriptions.zh:
我们对太空有机生物的掌握促成我们开发出被称之为§Y虚空诱饵§!的东西。

这些设备旨在呼唤太空中的野生生物，吸引在虚空中避难的有机生命体。我们不确定会吸引什么，但目前我们正在广播的频率正在返回规律且镜像的响应。

有东西正向我们而来。
descriptions.en:
Our mastery of spaceborne organisms has led to the development of what we are calling §YVoidlures§!.

These devices are designed to call into the wilds of space and attract organisms that take shelter in the void. We are not sure what we might attract, but the current frequencies we are broadcasting are returning regular and mirrored responses.

Something is coming to us.

descriptions.zh:
我们对太空有机生物的掌握促成我们开发出被称之为§Y虚空诱饵§!的东西。

这些模块必须安装在各种太空兽群对应原生恒星系内的驿站上。建成后，它们将周期性地吸引生物种群到驿站来。安装有虚空诱饵阵列的方舟舰可以召唤我们遇到的生物，将它们引诱到任何它们所能栖息的恒星系。

我们应保持警惕，因为某些类型的生物可能会变得具有攻击性。
descriptions.en:
Our mastery of spaceborne organisms has led to the development of what we are calling §YVoidlures§!.

These modules must be installed on Waystations within the native systems of each particular kind of Space Fauna. Once established, they will periodically attract fleets of creatures to the Waystation. An Arkship equipped with a Voidlure Array may instead call to fauna we have encountered, drawing them to any system that is home to their kind.

We should be cautious, as certain types of organisms could become aggressive.

descriptions.zh:
我们对太空有机生物的掌握促成我们开发出被称之为§Y虚空诱饵§!的东西。

这些恒星基地建筑必须建造在每种特定太空兽群的原生恒星系中。建成后，它们将定期吸引呈舰队般集群的生物前往该恒星基地。

我们应该谨慎，因为某些类型的生物可能会变得具有攻击性。
descriptions.en:
Our mastery of spaceborne organisms has led to the development of what we are calling §YVoidlures§!.

These starbase buildings must be built within the native systems of each particular kind of Space Fauna. Once established, they will periodically attract fleets of creatures to the starbase.

We should be cautious, as certain types of organisms could become aggressive.

options.script: name = FASCINATING

descriptions.zh:
我们之前研发的§Y虚空诱饵§!吸引了一群来自其他恒星系的太空鲸鱼，这些恒星系类似[This.Capital.System.GetName]，均含有§Y气态巨行星§!。

看来我们的设备必须在这些环境中建造才能正常工作。如果我们发现其他野生动物，我们应该也能在它们的自然栖息地附近建造虚空诱饵。
descriptions.en:
The §YVoidlure§! we had previously developed attracted a group of space whales native to systems with §YGas Giants§! akin to [This.Capital.System.GetName].

It seems our devices must be built in those environments to work properly. Should we discover other wild fauna, we should be able to construct Voidlures near their natural habitats as well.

options.script: name = VERYWELL

descriptions.zh: 随着最近§Y重力陷阱§!的发现，现在[root.GetAdjective]科研船可以发射重力陷阱。
descriptions.en: Following the recent discovery of §YGravity Snares§!, [root.GetAdjective] science ships are now able to launch Gravity Snares.

descriptions.zh:
这些非致命抛射体可以安全地捕获并将太空兽群转运到我们的§Y生态园§!里，让它们得以继续繁衍生息。

屠宰分解这些生物可以用来收获其§Y基因物质§!以进行克隆以及获得其他资源。
descriptions.en:
These non-lethal projectiles can safely capture and transport Space Fauna to our §YVivarium§!, where they can continue to reproduce new specimens of their kind.

Culling and dissecting these creatures will allow the harvesting of their §YGenetic Material§! for cloning purposes as well as other resources.

descriptions.zh:
这些非致命抛射体可以安全地捕获以及转运太空兽群用于研究及解剖，从而收获其§Y基因物质§!和其他资源。

如果我们打算豢养并进一步繁育这些生物，我们需要建立一座§Y生态园§!。可以通过建造一座§Y博物天枢§!或是在恒星基地上建造建筑§Y[GetHatcheryPlural]§!来实现。
descriptions.en:
These non-lethal projectiles can safely capture and transport Space Fauna for study and dissection, harvesting their §YGenetic Material§! and resources.

If we are to keep them alive for further breeding, we will need to establish a §YVivarium§!. We can do this by constructing a §YGrand Archive§! or by building §Y[GetHatcheryPlural]§! at our starbases.

options.script: name = VERYWELL

descriptions.zh:
我们的§Y重力陷阱§!无法准确地追踪收容§Y虫群天灾§!。基于其运动模式，我们怀疑这些物种应该是被某种更高级的意识所控制着，不具备真正意义上的独立个体。

尝试将一只该生物收容进生态园会威胁到其他物种甚至整个[this.GetName]。

我们已无限期地暂停了对这些生物的捕获行动。
descriptions.en:
Our §YGravity Snares§! are unable to properly track and contain the §YPrethoryn Scourge§!. Based on their movement patterns, we suspect these beings are being controlled by some form of higher consciousness and are not truly individual entities.

Attempting to contain one of these organisms within a Vivarium would endanger our other specimens and even [this.GetName] as a whole.

We have suspended capture operations for these organisms indefinitely.

options.script: name = grand_archive.7220.a

descriptions.zh: 我们的§H[fromfrom.GetClass]§!§Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!在[fromfromfrom.GetName]战斗中被[from.GetName]俘虏。他们要求支付赎金以交换[fromfrom.GetHisHer]的性命。
descriptions.en: Our §H[fromfrom.GetClass]§! §Y[fromfrom.GetName]§! has been captured by [from.GetName] during the battle in [fromfromfrom.GetName]. They have demanded ransom in exchange for [fromfrom.GetHisHer] life.

descriptions.zh: 正如先前通报，我们的指挥官[fromfrom.GetName]被[from.GetName]俘虏，他们愿意接受支付赎金以换取[fromfrom.GetHisHer]的生命。
descriptions.en: As previously reported, our Commander [fromfrom.GetName] has been captured by [from.GetName] who are willing to accept payment in exchange for [fromfrom.GetHisHer] life.

tooltips.zh: [fromfrom.GetName]将被释放并回归我们的队伍。
tooltips.en: [fromfrom.GetName] will be released and return to our ranks.

descriptions.zh: 由于[from.GetName]拒绝支付[fromfrom.GetHisHer]的赎金，敌军指挥官[fromfrom.GetName]仍被我们扣押。[fromfrom.GetHisHer]的命运将如何？
descriptions.en: Following the unwillingness of [from.GetName] to pay for [fromfrom.GetHisHer] return, enemy Commander [fromfrom.GetName] remains in our custody. What is to be [fromfrom.GetHisHer] fate?

descriptions.zh: 我们对[From.GetShipCategoryName]的克隆工作取得了基因突破。将这些生物独特的解剖结构与我们在基因操控方面的专业知识结合起来，或许可以创造出一种独特的变异体。
descriptions.en: Our [From.GetShipCategoryName] cloning efforts have resulted in a genetic breakthrough. It might be possible to combine these creature's unique anatomy with our expertise in gene manipulation to create a unique type of Mutation.

titles.zh: 太空变形虫变异计划完成

descriptions.zh:
我们关于§Y空间变形虫§!的变异实验完成了，得到了一些有趣的新细胞器：可部署的§Y吸血鞭毛§!。

这些共生生物能够从附近物体中汲取能量并将其返还给宿主，从而增强生存能力和再生能力。
descriptions.en:
Our experimental mutation project on §YSpace Amoebas§! is complete, and has yielded some interesting new organelles: deployable §YLeechcraft§!.

These symbiotic organisms are able to drain energy from nearby objects and return it to its host, enhancing survivability and regeneration.

options.script:
name = INTERESTING
give_technology = { tech = tech_unique_mutation_space_amoeba }

descriptions.zh:
我们对§Y缇扬奇§!的变异实验完成了，得到了一个有趣的结果：§Y群兽合唱§!

我们已经将这些生物在它们群体中用于交流的自然振动放大到可持续的最大水平。这将产生一个可控的场，增强附近其他生物的组织。
descriptions.en:
Our experimental mutation project on §YTiyankis§! is complete, and has yielded some interesting enhancements: §YHerdsong Chords§!

We have amplified the natural vibrations these creatures use for communication within their herds to the maximum sustainable level. This results in a controllable field that strengthens the tissue of other nearby creatures.

options.script:
name = INTERESTING
give_technology = { tech = tech_unique_mutation_tiyanki }

descriptions.zh:
我们对§Y虚空虫§!的变异实验完成了，得到了一些有趣的繁殖周期变异：§Y剧毒囊肿§!

我们已经能够提高这些生物用来轰炸宿主星球的寄生囊肿的繁殖能力。结果是产生的若虫产量增加。
descriptions.en:
Our experimental mutation project on §YVoidworms§! is complete, and has yielded some interesting variations of their reproductive cycles: §YVirulent Cysts§!

We have been able to increase the fertility of the parasitic cysts these creatures use to bombard their host planets with. The result is an increase in yield of generated nymphs.

options.script:
name = INTERESTING
give_technology = { tech = tech_unique_mutation_voidworm }

descriptions.zh:
我们对§Y岩居兽§!的变异实验完成了，得到了一个有趣的结果：§Y胃袋喷泉§!

我们已经找到方法能将其巨大消化系统改造为发射高初速长射程弹药的武器。不幸的是，这一显著的生物学改造会导致它们无法再吞噬敌方舰船了。
descriptions.en:
Our experimental mutation project on §YCutholoids§! is complete, and has yielded some interesting results: §YGastric Fountain§!

We have found a way to repurpose their massive digestive system to fire high velocity, long-range projectiles. Unfortunately, this significant biological modification will mean they are no longer able to engulf enemy fleets.

options.script:
name = INTERESTING
give_technology = { tech = tech_unique_mutation_cutholoid }

titles.zh: 晶态实体变异计划完成

descriptions.zh:
我们关于§Y晶态实体§!的变异实验完成了，得到了一些有趣的结果：§Y分裂核心§!

通过对它们晶体基因的这种修改，每个生物在遭受严重创伤时能够分裂成两个独立的个体。这将极大地提高它们的战斗能力。
descriptions.en:
Our experimental mutation project on §YCrystalline Entities§! is complete, and has yielded some interesting results: §YFissile Cores§!

With this modification to their crystalline genetics, each creature is capable of splitting into two independent organisms in the event of severe trauma. This should drastically improve their combat capabilities.

options.script:
name = INTERESTING
give_technology = { tech = tech_unique_mutation_crystalline_entity }

descriptions.zh:
我们已经从[FromFromFrom.GetShipSizeName]所在的[FromFrom.solar_system.GetName]星系中获得了该生物的遗传物质。

虽然我们目前无法克隆这种生物，但我们仍然可以从其独特的生物学特性中提取宝贵的见解。
descriptions.en:
We have recovered the genetic material of the [FromFromFrom.GetShipSizeName] we encountered in [FromFrom.solar_system.GetName].

Though we lack the understandings to clone such a creature, we may still be able to extract valuable insight from its unique biology.

descriptions.zh:
我们使用缇扬奇族母的遗传物质进行的变异实验完成了，得到了一些有趣的结果：§H自我再生酶§!

族母遗传物质中存在的修复酶可以在其他生物的类似腺体中复制。这将它们的结构组织转化为再生材料，在爆炸时紧密编队中会非常有用。
descriptions.en:
Our experimental mutation project using Tiyanki Matriarch genetic material is complete, and has yielded some interesting results: §HRestorative Enzymes§!

The restorative enzymes present in the Matriarch's genetic material can be reproduced in similar glands on other creatures. This transforms their structural tissue into regenerative material, which would provide quite useful in tight formations upon explosion.

descriptions.zh:
我们已经从[FromFromFrom.GetShipSizeName]所在的[FromFrom.solar_system.GetName]星系中获得了该生物的遗传物质。

虽然我们目前无法克隆这种生物，但我们仍然可以从其独特的生物学特性中提取宝贵的见解。
descriptions.en:
We have recovered the genetic material of the [FromFromFrom.GetShipSizeName] we encountered in [FromFrom.solar_system.GetName].

Though we lack the understandings to clone such a creature, we may still be able to extract valuable insight from its unique biology.

titles.zh: 虚空孳孽变异计划完成

descriptions.zh:
我们使用虚空孳孽基因材料进行的变异实验完成了，得到了一个有趣的发现：§H星养生理§!

这些生物的组织对星光反应强烈，可以被鼓励在其他生物体中生长。这需要少量能量来维持，但在最亮的恒星附近，它们的生长速度会大幅提高。
descriptions.en:
Our experimental mutation project using Voidspawn genetic material is complete, and has yielded an interesting discovery: §HStarborne Biology§!

The tissue of these creatures reacts strongly to starlight, and can be encouraged to grow in other organisms. This demands a small amount of energy to maintain, but vastly improves their growth rate near the brightest stars.

descriptions.zh: 我们在[from.solar_system.GetName]成功捕获了第一批野生太空兽群，我们相信只要投入足够的科学资金，就可以克隆出更多这样的生物。
descriptions.en: With our first successful capture of wild Space Fauna in [from.solar_system.GetName], we believe it possible to clone more of these creatures with the proper scientific investment.

descriptions.zh:
在[from.solar_system.GetName]成功克隆出首例太空兽群。

我们对异星生物学的深入研究表明，我们可以进一步增强这些生物的生理机能，如果我们选择这样做的话。这将使我们能够为生物舰队配备专门的战斗组件。
descriptions.en:
The first successfully cloned Space Fauna has been created in [from.solar_system.GetName].

Our research into xenobiology indicates even more can be done to enhance these creatures' physiologies, should we choose to do so. This will allow us to outfit our biological fleets with specialized combat components.
